feedback_contract: Compare against a relevant baseline or expectation
Identify affected dependency and likely bottleneck
Revise the intervention or metric when evidence warrants

presentation_contract.CoSpeedo: Lead with the user's goal, current capability, material degradation, freshness and next action. Drill down to relational evidence. No universal health score.
presentation_contract.CoOomph: Use measured useful yield and receiver capacity to pace work; do not equate worker count or animation speed with benefit.
presentation_contract.visual_design: Quiet hierarchy, readable contrast, stable layout, meaningful color plus text, optional motion, reduced-motion and screen-reader equivalents. No decorative telemetry presented as real.

observations.subject: X2 Terminal intervention
observations.before: Windows reported an unresponsive Terminal process and hung windows.
observations.after: User reported improved responsiveness; later clarified external PERIX keyboard still routed to X1.
observations.verification: Follow-up remote command timed out; do not claim independently verified restart or complete input recovery.

observations.subject: Session evidence audit canary
observations.result: 12 fixture cases passed on X2; live snapshot had 1 reported-current evidence category and 5 unknown categories.
observations.scope: Supplied evidence coverage only; no proof capabilities are absent. One-shot execution, no recurring audit.

cross_domain_extension.typing_rule: Every relation retains its domain, source, evidence class, scale, units if meaningful, assumptions, permitted transformations, projection loss, uncertainty and authority scope. CoTerms whose historic bindings remain unresolved retain that uncertainty.
cross_domain_extension.golden_thread_proposal: An inspectable provenance-and-dependency path from source question through interpretation, metric, experiment, outcome and revision; metaphorical label, not evidence of an unknown causal force.
cross_domain_extension.candidate_space: Generate addressable combinations lazily; no assertion that every combination is defined, meaningful, independent, instrumentable or simultaneously executed.
activation_rules: Compare expected information or user benefit with cost
Elect qualified authorized workers and independent review where useful
Record omitted dimensions and failed/inconclusive outcomes
Preserve dissent and avoid correlated model outputs being counted as independent confirmations
cross_domain_extension.evaluation: Compare cross-domain routing against a narrower baseline: fewer missed dependencies, less duplicate work, better forecast calibration, faster recovery, useful completed outcomes and resource cost. More connections alone do not prove coherence or synergy.

source_retention_extension.scope: Available authorized source material from humans, synthetic participants and other attributable sources. No claim of a complete audio/video recording or all-session capture.
source_contract: Preserve exact wording when supplied and retained; distinguish transcript from original audio.
Keep source identity, timestamp, capture modality, transcription uncertainty, version and access scope.
Keep private raw sources out of public GitHub; publish only deliberately public-safe derivatives.
Link each derivative to its source span and label quotation, paraphrase, editorial revision, fiction, satire or metaphor.
Do not attribute generated words to a real participant or infer that an entity consented merely because it was quoted.
retention_factors: Recent use and expected retrieval value
source_retention_extension.decay_semantics: Decay can reduce hot storage, indexing or review priority without changing source bytes. Compression must declare loss; exact evidence should remain recoverable where required. Archiving is not deletion.
source_retention_extension.staleness_rule: Outdated operational claims remain source-time evidence; valid-time/currentness must be distinguished from historical value. Popularity or non-use alone must not decide factual authority or destruction.
source_retention_extension.quote_ecology: CoQuotable is a candidate handle for attributed quotable spans across participant types. Meme and mythic Rick/clone renditions must be visibly distinguished from historical records; preserve dissenting and less-popular voices.
source_retention_extension.reprocessing_rule: Use source cursors and extraction-version manifests to identify processed spans, unresolved residue, new interpretations and diminishing returns. No claim that a source can be permanently drained of every future meaning.
